insights.content: DTC #3 is 5-0, the only unbeaten team in the division. W5 win over Anthem was clean: Yarisbel dominated Rivera 6-1 6-3 at S1, Shi/Darian won D1 6-2 6-3, Emmy/Moon won D2 6-4 6-4, and Kara/Rachel ground out a D3 tiebreak. Only loss was S2 (Anna Clark lost to Anthem's Kelly Twells). DTC #3 now controls their destiny — win W7 vs Summerlin to lock first place.

TPC collapsed 0-5 to Summerlin — their biggest result of the season was swept aside entirely. TPC drops to 3-2, Anthem drops to 3-2, Summerlin rises to 3-2. Three teams now tied at 3-2 behind DTC #3. The threat hierarchy has flipped: Summerlin is now the most dangerous team in Subflight A.

W7 (5/2) vs Summerlin is now the danger match. Tayoni Coleman (3.106→3.303, 4-0) bageled TPC's S1 player 6-0 6-0 — she is the division's best singles player and will face Yarisbel (3.085→3.204, 4-0). That S1 line is a coin flip at best. Nathalia (3.16) + Springer (3.27) went 6-3 6-0 at D1 today — they are DTC #3's D1 pair's biggest test yet.

TPC (W6 opponent, 4/25) is no longer a serious threat. After the 0-5 rout, Jennifer Wang (2.87→2.95, 2-1) looks mortal — she lost S2 today in a 3-setter. Their D1 pair (Chikhani/Lenhart) got crushed 6-3 6-0 by Nathalia/Springer. Expect a comfortable DTC #3 win in W6 — 4-1 or better.

Most underrated after W5: Shi Oskooi (2.84→3.12, +0.28, 5-0), Yarisbel Schieck (3.09→3.20, 4-0), Tayoni Coleman (3.11→3.30, 4-0), Darian McCauley (2.98→3.17, 4-0), Kelly Twells (Anthem, 2.98→3.17, 4-0). Kelly Twells is quietly Anthem's best player — she beat DTC #3's Anna Clark at S2 today while Gina Rivera was getting routed at S1.

Anthem put Maddux (2.72) + Laudenslager (3.01) at D1 against Shi/Darian — a mismatch they lost 6-2 6-3. Shi/Darian are now 4-0 together at D1, their only real test being the W1 Shirey+Frazier upset. Nathalia (3.14) + Springer (3.19, post-adjustment) are the only pair in the subflight likely to push them.

Kara Gaston (3.09→2.86) and Rachel Glaze (2.83→2.80) won D3 today 4-6 6-1 1-0 — their first win together. This is important: D3 was the soft underbelly in previous weeks. Rachel is 2-0 overall, Kara now 1-1. Keep this pair together at D3.

sections.title: 04/25 — next match preview: DTC #3 vs TPC

insights.content: DTC #3 (5-0) at TPC (3-2). TPC just got swept 0-5 by Summerlin. Their roster is thinner than their early-season results suggested. This should be a comfortable win.

TPC's S1 option is likely Amber Candelaria (2.98) — she was bageled 6-0 6-0 by Coleman today. Yarisbel (3.20 dynamic) should win comfortably. If they push Jennifer Wang (2.95) back to S1, Yarisbel still has the edge.
TPC's D1 pair (Chikhani 2.77 + Lenhart 2.96) lost 6-3 6-0 to Nathalia/Springer. Shi/Darian should win this handily.
DTC #3 wins 4-1 or 5-0. The only swing line is S2 — Anna Clark (3.10→2.97) vs TPC's S2. TPC's depth beyond Wang has not been impressive.
vs TPC (3-2). TPC just got swept 0-5 by Summerlin — no longer a serious test. Comfortable win expected.

vs SUMMERLIN ARBORS (3-2) — now the must-win. Tayoni Coleman (3.30 dynamic, 4-0) vs Yarisbel at S1 is the marquee line. Nathalia (3.14) + Springer (3.19) at D1 is DTC #3's hardest doubles test. Brittany Carlson (2.76→2.86, 4-1) is a wildcard at D2/D3. This match decides first place.
vs SOUTHERN HIGHLANDS (1-3). Already beat them 4-1 in W2. Comfortable win expected.
vs RED ROCK CC (1-4). Already beat them 3-2 in W3. Should win 3-2+.

DTC #3 is 2 games clear of everyone at 5-0. Win W6 (TPC, very likely) and W7 (Summerlin, competitive) to clinch 1st outright. Even losing W7 keeps DTC #3 in the driver's seat given the remaining schedule.
